canonical_target: Mark III modular/linkable field-control and processing platform
units: SI unless an export scale states otherwise

source_conflicts.description: The Free Flow Mark III scenario lists a 0.16 m solenoid length; six such units cannot be arranged axially inside the 0.75 m source envelope with couplers and service space.
source_conflicts.resolution: Use six compact 0.055 m spatial-reference cartridges. Preserve the 0.16 m Free Flow value as a quarantined scenario input pending measured BOM and integration review.

source_conflicts.description: Source workbooks describe synthetic energy, RFS and EMFF behavior without measured logs.
source_conflicts.resolution: Represent component interfaces and sensor locations only; exclude performance values from geometry and capability claims.

known_unknowns.description: Qualified material stack, fastener system and panel tolerance are unknown.
Coupler structural loads, sealing, alignment tolerance and repeated-cycle life are unknown.
Solenoid conductor, turn count, insulation, current, thermal rejection and field map are unverified.
RFS resonator frequency, acceleration, coupling and assay response require controlled tests and blanks.
Battery, BMS and capacitor architecture requires pulse logs, ESR/DCIR, fault containment and thermal review.
Cable gauges, connector families, shielding, grounding and minimum bend radii require electrical design.
Arm joint loads, actuator selection, tendon/spool sizing, torque, reach and collision limits are unknown.
Damping chamber medium, pressure, containment and venting remain specialist-review placeholders.
Array-level bus sharing, synchronization, thermal interaction, field interaction and coupler loads are unknown.
Manufacturing method, inspection, assembly sequence and repair certification are not established.

claim_gates: No validated extraction, separation, efficiency, field-strength, current or material-response claim.
No high-current build instructions or energy-safety approval.
No pressure, vacuum, gas-handling, thermal, flight, human-rating or payload-handling certification.
No arm torque, reach, capture, deployment, load or collision-avoidance claim.
No manufacturing release, public capability promotion or operational deployment approval.
Synthetic RFS/EMFF and Free Flow values remain quarantined from active capability inputs.
